newsitem.title: USA: Wanderlust seeks to restructure debentures.
newsitem.headline: Wanderlust seeks to restructure debentures.

text.p: Wanderlust Interactive Inc said Tuesday it did not pay back its $507,500 in outstanding debentures due May 19 and said it is unable to repay them without additional financing.

The company said it is seeking to restructure the debentures by offering to convert them into shares of common stock at a lower conversion price, or by extending the debentures and giving holders additional common shares.
Wanderlust said about 25 percent of the debtholders have already accepted the restructuring, but it could not predict whether it would successfully conclude the restructuring.
